items.title: No proof of results on the site yet
items.description: Top reason a prospect says no to a young studio. Partly addressed by Research Sprint and ownership promises. Add a case study when the user has one (see memory pending-case-study).

items.title: Keep customer-policy.html in sync with new promises
items.description: Ownership and Research Sprint promises contradict the current policy wording ("set out in your proposal"). Update customer-policy.html, contact FAQ, services and research pages with one identical wording.

items.title: Pricing opaque: explain fee structure without figures
items.description: Add services.html#fee with the three result-linked fee mechanisms. No figures by decision of the user.

items.title: Nav duplicated in 10 HTML files: guard with a check script
items.description: No build step (over-engineering for 10 pages). A Node check that the nav block is identical across pages catches drift.

items.title: Manual sync points: sitemap, llms.txt, dateModified, FAQPage JSON-LD
items.description: Verify with scripted checks on every content change.

items.title: Second entry point besides "Book a call"
items.description: research.html with the Research Sprint gives visitors a concrete, lower-risk first step.

items.title: Human read of the new contractual text in customer-policy.html
items.description: Gate G13: the user (or a lawyer) reads the Ownership, How we start and Duration sections before publishing.

items.title: Verify the geo redirect on the deployed site (i18n G12)
items.description: After deploy: from a Romanian IP, / -> 307 /ro and /index.html -> 200 English; from abroad, / -> 200 English; /ro -> 200. The local python server cannot simulate x-vercel-ip-country.

items.title: Owner reads the Romanian copy, especially ro/privacy-policy and ro/customer-policy (i18n G13)
items.description: A stilted translation reads as cheap to a Romanian buyer, and the legal pages carry contractual wording. Read all 9 pages under ro/ before publishing.

items.title: Every EN content edit must be mirrored in its ro/ twin
items.description: 19 HTML files now share header/footer and structure. Run node .unlazy/i18n/verify.mjs parity (and the other modes) after any content change; parity fails when a section, list item or id exists in only one language.

items.title: Romanian OG share image
items.description: RO pages reuse assets/img/og.png, whose text is English. A link shared on WhatsApp/Facebook from /ro/ shows an English card.

items.title: Homepage CTA repeated 3x: evaluate fatigue after first real traffic
items.description: index.html and ro/index.html now carry the same Calendly button in the hero, in the free-preview section and in the closing band. Without proof on the page a third repetition may tire a prospect. Check Clarity recordings once traffic exists; if the middle button is ignored, remove it from both pages (keep the research.html next-link) and re-run node .unlazy/i18n/verify.mjs parity.

items.title: Redesign step 2: apply the CSS system's structure to the other 8 pages and their ro/ twins
items.description: Only index.html and ro/index.html got eyebrows, the hero CTA, the preview section and the .section--cta band. services, how-you-sell, research, process, team, contact and the two policy pages inherit typography, cards, numerals and bands automatically but keep their old structure. Any structural change to an EN page must be mirrored in ro/ in the same commit because node .unlazy/i18n/verify.mjs parity compares ids and element counts per pair.

items.title: Isolate bilingual work from parallel font session
items.description: Worked in a scratch copy and 3-way merged back: 57 files clean, 43 created, 0 conflicts; font/team-cards session edits kept.

items.title: Prove EN pages unchanged by the RO work
items.description: Gate G2: EN prerender byte-identical to the pre-change render (switch, two wrappers and /assets slashes normalised).

items.title: t(en, ro) layer + full RO version of all 6 pages at /ro/
items.description: t/L/useLink in src/i18n; all 6 pages at /ro/; G3 parity + G3b source scan pass (no English left, incl. hidden states).

items.title: RO links and assets root-absolute; EN home link never "/"
items.description: G5/G6: RO links root-absolute, EN home never "/", RO->EN home switch is /index.html.

items.title: vercel.json geo redirect: x-vercel-ip-country RO, only "/"
items.description: vercel.json rule verified by a simulator (G7) and matches Vercel's documented header-redirect form; not tested on a live deploy.

items.title: html lang, hreflang and hydration lang agreement
items.description: G4 head/hreflang/og:locale; hydration verified in real Chrome (G10) and the in-app browser.

items.title: Language switch visible on mobile header, desktop nav and footer
items.description: EN | RO switch in desktop nav, mobile header and footer on all 12 pages (G6, G10).

items.title: RO copy quality, overflow at 375px, facts identical to EN policy
items.description: Layout and policy checked (G10, G11). Owner still to read: contact "Lucrăm în română și în engleză", FAQ "pagină de Facebook", shortened hero CTA, "Schiță de poziționare".

items.title: Revisit 6 duplicate src/entries/ro-*.jsx if Vite stops emitting 13 module scripts for shared entries
items.description: Sharing one entry module between EN and RO shells made Vite 8 emit 13 script tags instead of 1 plus modulepreloads. Separate 4-line RO entries avoid it. Drop them if a future Vite handles shared entries.

items.title: ro-react oracle: en-unchanged baseline and deps gate are point-in-time
items.description: .unlazy/ro-react/ref/en holds the EN render from before the RO work. After the next intentional EN edit, regenerate it (or drop gate G2). Gates ro/head/links/switch/geo/fonts/browser stay valid as the site evolves.
